_howto: HR tours. steps = page tour (first visit). sections = one tour per HR area (starts the first time that area is opened) plus pop-up form tours (overlay, offered the first time the form opens). Guides are in hr_dashboard_guides.json. To announce something NEW, add a step with a NEW id. Rewording keeps the id. Never reuse an id.
title: HR tour
whatsNewText: We've added something new here since you last took the tour.

steps.title: Welcome to HR Management
steps.text:
Contracts and onboarding, disciplinary records, performance notes, HR KPIs and approval routing, all in one place.

Use Next and Back, or your arrow keys. Press Esc to close.

steps.title: All HR areas
steps.text: Every HR area is listed here.

steps.title: Dashboard Overview
steps.text: Your headline HR numbers: staff, infringements, performance notes, pending onboarding, and missing or expiring contracts. Click a card to go straight to the detail.

steps.title: Core KPIs
steps.text: Attendance KPIs such as the Bradford Factor, attendance and absenteeism rates, overtime, on-time arrival and leave used, per employee, department or the whole company, with printable reports.

steps.title: Employee Master
steps.text: The same Employee Master, opened inside HR so you don't have to leave this screen.

steps.title: Infringements
steps.text: Record and track disciplinary infringements and warnings.

steps.title: Performance Notes
steps.text: Notes on an employee's performance, good or bad, kept on their record.

steps.title: Contracts & Onboarding
steps.text: Contract templates, assigning contracts, approvals, and the contracts audit.

steps.title: Workflows
steps.text: The approval steps your HR processes follow, and who handles each step.

steps.title: Routing & Stand-ins
steps.text: Who approves for which part of the organisation, and who stands in when they're away.

steps.title: HR Settings
steps.text: General HR settings, the categories and types used in HR, and your HR rules.

steps.title: Make more room
steps.text: Collapse the menu to icons only, and click again to open it.

steps.title: Where you are
steps.text: The name of the area that is open right now.

steps.title: Refresh Data
steps.text: Reloads all HR data, for example after someone else has made changes.

steps.title: Search any screen
steps.text:
Type what you're looking for, like contract or leave, to jump straight to any screen you have access to, in any module.

Point at the search bar without typing to see your most visited screens, and pin your favourites.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Click your name for your profile, other areas of the system, and logout. Let's look inside.

steps.title: Launchpad
steps.text: Back to your home screen with all your modules.

steps.title: Profile
steps.text: Your account: your name, role and when you last signed in. Update your name and email, see your employee record, or change your password on the Security tab. Saving any change asks for your current password, so nobody else can change your account.

steps.title: Settings
steps.text: Company-wide setup. Only shown to users allowed to change settings.

steps.title: ESS
steps.text: Your own self service: leave, claims, payslips and documents.

steps.title: Connect a Phone
steps.text: Shows a QR code that connects a company phone to your company. It contains your licence key, so only show it while setting up phones.

steps.title: Download the App
steps.text: Shows a QR code to download the Android app onto a phone.

steps.title: Help & Tours
steps.text: Opens the same help menu as the ? button.

steps.title: Dark Mode
steps.text: Switch between dark and light. Your choice follows your login to any computer.

steps.title: Logout
steps.text: Always log out on a shared computer.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Click your name for Toggle Theme, Launchpad and Logout.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: Click ? for this page tour, a tour of the area you're in, what's new, and hands-on how-to guides, such as writing a contract template or assigning a contract.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.text: Each HR area also has its own short tour. It starts the first time you open that area, and you can replay it any time from ?.

steps.title: Your HR at a glance
steps.text: Live counts across HR. Click any card to open the list behind the number.

steps.title: Total Staff
steps.text: Your active employees. Opens Employee Master.

steps.title: Infringements and Performance Notes
steps.text: How many records there are. Each card opens its list.

steps.title: Pending Onboard
steps.text: Contracts waiting in Awaiting Approval.

steps.title: Missing Signed Copies
steps.text: Contracts whose signed copy hasn't been uploaded yet. Opens the Contracts Audit filtered to Missing Physical Copy, where you upload them from each row.

steps.title: Expiring Contracts
steps.text: Contracts ending this month. Opens the Contracts Audit filtered to Expiring in Month, where the arrows move to other months.

steps.title: Period
steps.text: Choose the start and end date to measure.

steps.title: Department
steps.text: Measure one department, or leave it empty for the whole company.

steps.title: Individual
steps.text: Or pick one employee. The x clears the choice.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.text: Works out the KPIs for your choice. Always click this after changing the period or filters; the cards, charts and reports use the last calculation.

steps.title: The seven KPIs
steps.text:
• Bradford Factor: how disruptive absences are. Many short absences score higher than one long one.
• Attendance Rate: hours worked out of hours scheduled.
• Absenteeism Rate: scheduled time lost to unplanned absence.
• Overtime %: overtime out of all hours worked.
• On-Time Arrival: clock-ins at or before the shift start.
• PTO Utilized: scheduled time taken as paid leave.
• Shift Coverage: scheduled shifts that had someone present.

steps.title: Click a card for the detail
steps.text:
Each card opens its formula with your actual figures, and a verdict: green (healthy), amber (watch it) or red (act now).

For example, the Bradford Factor is (absence spells × spells) × days absent: under 50 is healthy, 50 to 100 is a warning, and over 100 is critical.

steps.title: Trends
steps.text: Week-on-Week and Month-on-Month charts show how hours and rates are moving over time.

steps.title: Reports
steps.text:
Print a report of the last calculation:
• Employee Report: pick an individual first.
• Dept Report: pick a department first, with its top performers, latecomers and absentees.
• Company Report: department and employee rankings across the company.

steps.title: Employee Master in HR
steps.text:
The full Employee Master, opened inside HR. Everything works exactly as it does on its own page.

It has its own ? button (bottom left of this area) for Employee Master's tours and how-to guides, such as creating an employee.

steps.title: Four tabs
steps.text:
Contracts Audit checks everyone's contract. Assign Contract gives an employee a contract. Awaiting Approval is where new contracts are approved. Contract Templates is where your contracts are written or imported.

The usual order: set up a template, assign it, approve it, then keep an eye on the audit.

steps.title: Contract Templates
steps.text:
Two ways to set up a contract:
• Import Contract PDF: use your existing contract exactly as it is, then mark where the employee's details go.
• Create New Template: write the contract here, with placeholders that fill in each employee's details.

Each template can be edited, mapped (PDFs) or deactivated. ? → How-to guides walks you through both.

steps.title: Assign Contract
steps.text: Choose the employee, the template and the dates (or Permanent), and optionally the wage. A contract with an end date terminates the employee automatically on that date.

steps.title: Awaiting Approval
steps.text: New contracts wait here. The icons open any signatures and documents, and the printer opens the contract PDF. Approve lets you confirm the department, PIN and wage, then Approve & Activate.

steps.title: Contracts Audit
steps.text: Check everyone at once: who has an active contract, who has no contract, whose signed paper copy is missing, and whose contract is expiring in a month you pick with the arrows.

steps.title: Narrow it down
steps.text: Filter by department or search by name, surname or PIN, then click Filter Audit. Tick the box to include terminated employees.

steps.title: Each employee's contract
steps.text: The contract type, dates and whether a signed physical copy is on file. The buttons on each row print the contract, upload the signed copy, edit the wage details, or swap to another template.

steps.title: Infringement records
steps.text: Every disciplinary infringement recorded against an employee: the date, the rule broken and its severity. They're captured on the mobile app, with a photo, signature and location where available.

steps.title: Date range
steps.text: Show records between two dates.

steps.title: One employee
steps.text: Type a name or PIN to see one person's record, then click Search. Clear resets the filters.

steps.title: On each record
steps.text:
• Evidence: open the photo, signature or the location on a map.
• Download PDF: the official record.
• Edit: change the rule (and severity), with a reason. Every edit is kept.
• History: every change made to the record, and by whom.
• Void: deactivate a record that was recorded in error.

steps.title: Rules and severities
steps.text: The rules you can record, and their severity (verbal, written, final written, dismissal), are set up in HR Settings.

steps.title: Performance notes
steps.text: Notes on an employee's performance, good or bad: the date, category and subject, and any evidence.

steps.title: Date range
steps.text: Show notes between two dates.

steps.title: One employee
steps.text: Type a name or PIN, then click Search. Clear resets the filters.

steps.title: Categories
steps.text: Performance note categories are set up in HR Settings > Categories.

steps.title: Workflows
steps.text: A workflow is a checklist of steps for onboarding, done in order. Each step is a task for someone: the new employee, their HOD, an approver from an approval hierarchy, or a specific person.

steps.title: Create a workflow
steps.text: Name it and choose how its steps are routed. Then add its steps from the workflow's card with Add Step.

steps.title: Your workflows
steps.text: Each card shows the workflow's steps in order, with buttons to edit or delete a step, edit the workflow, or deactivate it.

steps.title: Assign Workflow
steps.text: Choose a workflow and who it applies to: everyone, a department, or one employee.

steps.title: Deactivated
steps.text: Workflows you've switched off. Reactivate one to use it again.

steps.title: Routing & Stand-ins
steps.text: Approval Hierarchies decide who approves, level by level. Stand-in Management covers for managers who are away.

steps.title: Create a hierarchy
steps.text: Set up approval levels (Level 1, Level 2, and so on), each approved by a department or a specific user, plus an optional standing approver as a fallback.

steps.title: Your hierarchies
steps.text: Each hierarchy with its number of levels and its standing approver. Workflows set to System Hierarchy send their steps to these levels.

steps.title: Stand-ins
steps.text: Who takes over a manager's approvals, and from when to when. When the dates pass, approvals go back to the original manager.

steps.title: HR Settings
steps.text: General settings, the Categories used for infringements and performance notes, and your HR Rules.

steps.title: Auto-approve mobile contracts
steps.text: When ticked, contracts assigned from the mobile app become active straight away instead of waiting in Awaiting Approval. It saves as soon as you tick or untick it.

steps.title: Categories
steps.text: Groups for your rules and notes, for example Safety Gear or Attendance. Each category belongs to Infringements or Performance Notes and can be edited or switched off.

steps.title: HR Rules
steps.text: Each rule has a unique code, a category, a description and a severity: 1 verbal warning, 2 written warning, 3 final written warning, 4 termination/dismissal. These are what gets recorded as infringements.
